coach_rationale: 今天继续盯你最顽固的两处：过去式 -ed 结尾（looked、picked、showed）和动词短语连读（look through、pick out、put away、give away）。Mac 直读 EnglishPod365 笔记：自 10 月 16 日 EP0012 后没有新内容，弱项仍是 10 月 12 日、16 日两集暴露的 fill me in、kicked me out、pick up a 这类连读短语，所以本篇把整理旧物时的短语动词密度拉高，让你在慢速 TTS 里先把尾音和连读听清楚。
passage: Last Saturday, it rained all day, so I decided to stay at home and sort out the old boxes in the storage room. Although I had planned to clean them for months, I had always put it off because the boxes looked heavy and dusty. First, I opened the largest box and looked through hundreds of old photos. My mother laughed when she saw a photo of me at ten years old, because I had worn a very large coat and a funny hat. Then we picked out the photos that showed our family trips and put them into a new album. We threw away the broken ones, but we gave away two old cameras to my cousin, who still likes film photography. In the afternoon, my father joined us and told stories about each photo, although some of his stories sounded a little different from what my mother remembered. At five, we finished the work and ordered noodles for dinner. I felt happy because the room looked clean, and the old photos had found a new home.
